newsitem.title: USA: IBM climbs again, hits nine year highs.
newsitem.headline: IBM climbs again, hits nine year highs.

text.p: Shares of International Business Machines Corp climbed again, its fourth consecutive session reaching highs it has not seen since 1987, as investors viewed it as a relatively safer haven among technology shares.

IBM shares soared to an intra-session high of 159 and fell back slightly. In late morning, its shares were up 3-3/4 to 157-1/2. Traders said there was no new research on IBM but that the positive sentiment toward the stock is continuing because of its low valuation versus other technology stocks.
"If you are are bewildered with the market, it's an easy place to put a lot of money," one technology trader said.

IBM shares are trading at a lower price/earnings ratio than other technology stocks and currently, its shares are trading at about 14 times trailing earnings, which is even ahead of some analysts forecasts.

Wall Street's renewed love affair with IBM was also spilling over into other technology stocks, especially PC and PC component stocks. Shares were also fueled by positive comments on Tuesday by Compaq Computer Corp, which said it expects business to be excellent in the fourth quarter.
Dell Computer Corp added 5/8 to 98-3/8, Seagate Technology rose 2-7/8 to 77-7/8, Gateway 2000 jumped 1-5/8 to 56, Intel added 1-3/4 to 122-1/2.
